name: rafaella-cakes
description: Rafaella Cakes — loja virtual e encomendas de uma doceria artesanal

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.demo: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run demo:start
scripts.demo:start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
